+## Installation
+
+### Prerequisites
+
+- Python 3.12+
+- uv package manager
+
+### Steps
+
+1. Clone the repository:
+```bash
+git clone https://github.com/example/software-factory.git
+cd software-factory
+```
+
+2. Install dependencies:
+```bash
+uv venv && uv pip install -e ".[dev]"
+```
+
+3. Run tests:
+```bash
+pytest
+```
